alt: 學生對著近乎空白的計畫板大幅比劃，聽眾則指出空白企畫書等待具體細節。
scene_prompt: 高談闊論, using its common negative sense, means talking at length in grand abstract terms without concrete substance. In a modern school club meeting, a student stands energetically gesturing broadly before a small group, confidently describing a huge ambitious plan, while their presentation board remains nearly blank except for vague clouds and arrows. Classmates listen politely, but one points to an empty project page asking for practical details. Show expansive speech and gestures contrasted with lack of specifics, without words or speech bubbles. Keep tone gentle, not mocking. Natural anatomy, exactly two arms and legs, hand gestures connected, board supported and table grounded, perspective sensible.
